request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:GUARD

layers.text: Make his head a round fleshy face with pale blue-grey skin, a small nose, a stitched scar and droopy half-closed eyes instead of a skull, and his arms pale blue-grey skin with ivory bandaged hands. Keep the dark hair, the big red ragged smock, the arms stretched forward, pose, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
